sys_hub_action_type_definition.description:
Use this action when the student wants to view their current visa case information or list their available visa cases.
Use this action for questions such as: - What are my current visa cases? - What visa cases do I have? - Show my visa cases. - List my visa cases. - What is my current visa status? - What is my visa case status? - Show my case details.
Do NOT use this action when the student asks to summarize, review, explain, or provide an overview of a visa case.
For summary requests, use Get AI Case Summary instead.

{"case_context":{"scriptActive":true,"script":"var context =
 "Case Number: " + (inputs.case_number || "") +
 "\nCase Type: " + (inputs.case_type || "") +
 "\nStatus: " + (inputs.status || "") +
 "\nAssigned Advisor: " + (inputs.assigned_advisor || "") +
 "\nDue Date: " + (inputs.due_date || "") +
 "\nExpected Completion: " + (inputs.expected_completion || "") +
 "\nRisk Level: " + (inputs.risk_level || "") +
 "\nDecision: " + (inputs.decision || "");

return context;"}}
